worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.summary: Turn your back and whip your tail twice, left then right, dazing every foe that can see it in a 120-degree band behind you and lowering their Defense. You must turn a foe behind you first; enemies charging from the front are not swept. The tail must be seen, so cover blocks it.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.use.0: Turn and break the guard of a chaser behind you
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.use.1: Hold off the threat behind while you withdraw
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.use.2: Open a gap behind you for an ally's physical attacks
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.description.0: Foes swept by the tail truly lose %1$s Defense stage(s) and are marked guardbroken for %2$s; the mark itself changes no stats, but a target carrying it loses one more Defense stage to moves that rip open an old gap. The sweep deals no damage, and one foe is only dropped once across both swings.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.description.1: Tail radius %1$s catches every visible non-friendly in a 120-degree band behind you. Line of sight is required; cover blocks it.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.description.2: Windup %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. The committed direction sets your facing and the tail sweeps behind it; the second swing comes 6 ticks later and covers wherever you then stand, without turning to chase.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tailwhip.preference.ai: The companion only steps in to whip while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger approaches on its own.
The companion only whips when at least this many visible, not-yet-broken non-friendly bodies are inside the tail radius, so the windup is not wasted; 1 means whip whenever it sees one.
When on, the companion may leave its post to whip its tail under a Hold order.
